payload.name: Handymade
payload.description: 手工化妆品及香皂材料
payload.longDescription:
Handymade是欧洲在线商店，提供制作天然化妆品、香皂、蜡烛和其他手工制品的原材料和用品，包括油和脂类、乳化剂、防腐剂、活性成分、精油和香精、着色剂、蜡、模具、包装和工具，并支持多种欧盟语言的国家站点。

通过Handymade应用您可以使用自己的语言进行查询：
- 通过产品名称、成分、INCI名称或产品代码搜索，显示包装规格、含增值税的当前价格（以店铺货币计）、库存状态和产品链接；
- 查看与产品页完全一致的详细信息：产品描述、INCI名称、CAS编号、产地、配方中的作用、推荐使用量、加工温度、溶解性、认证信息等；
- 查阅质量文件：每批次的分析证书（检测结果与规格对比）、按产品类别划分的IFRA证书（最大使用量）、香精致敏原声明和技术数据表；
- 搜索Handymade的测试配方、教程指南、成分百科全书和化妆品法规文章；配方包含购物清单，每个原料均链接至对应产品。

该应用为只读模式，无需账户即可使用。
订单和支付需在Handymade网站完成。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search products with prices, package sizes and availability, Product specifications: INCI, CAS, usage level, certifications, Certificates of analysis per batch, IFRA limits per product category and fragrance allergens, Recipes with shopping lists, How-to guides and ingredient encyclopedia

payload.name: MeltFlex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Redesign real rooms from a single photo with MeltFlex in ChatGPT. Send a photo of a room, kitchen, bathroom, facade or garden, pick a style from the preset gallery or describe the change, and get back a photorealistic render that keeps the walls, windows and doors where they are. Refine the result through conversation.

With MeltFlex, you can:

• Browse 15 design tools and over 200 style presets with pictures, or jump in with /kitchen, /bathroom, /exterior, /garden, /walls, /floors, /stairs, /doors, /windows, /home-office, /closet, /coffee-shop and /restaurant.

• Restyle any room and compare two or three looks side by side.

• Furnish an empty room for a property listing with realistic virtual staging.

• Place an exact real product, such as a sofa, rug or tile, into your own room from its photo.

• Turn a render into a short cinematic walkthrough video for listings, Reels or TikTok.

• Turn a photo of a single furniture piece into a textured 3D model you can download as GLB.

Connect your MeltFlex account to get started.
payload.longDescription:
通过ChatGPT使用MeltFlex从单张照片重新设计真实房间。
发送房间、厨房、浴室、外观或花园的照片，从预设图库中选择风格或描述更改要求，即可获得逼真渲染效果，保持墙壁、窗户和门的位置不变。
通过对话进一步优化结果。

使用MeltFlex，您可以：

• 浏览15种设计工具和200多个带图片的风格预设，或直接使用/kitchen、/bathroom、/exterior、/garden、/walls、/floors、/stairs、/doors、/windows、/home-office、/closet、/coffee-shop和/restaurant命令。

• 重新设计任何房间并并排比较两种或三种不同风格。

• 为房产发布空房间进行现实主义虚拟布置。

• 将实际产品（如沙发、地毯或瓷砖）从其照片精确放置到您的房间中。

• 将渲染效果转换为电影级漫游视频，用于房源展示、Reels或TikTok发布。

• 将单件家具的照片转换为带纹理的3D模型，可下载为GLB格式。

连接您的MeltFlex账户即可开始使用。

payload.name: PromptKosh
payload.description: 创建具有特定风格的图像
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find a public PromptKosh style or use a style ID from promptkosh.in. PromptKosh sends the style prompt and any required inputs to ChatGPT, which can create the image using your ChatGPT account’s available image features. No PromptKosh account is needed.
payload.longDescription:
查找公共的PromptKosh风格或使用promptkosh.in提供的风格ID。
PromptKosh会将风格提示和必要输入发送至ChatGPT，即可通过你的ChatGPT账户可用的图像功能生成图像。
无需PromptKosh账户。

payload.name: Lazybird
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn scripts into ready-to-use voiceover MP3s without leaving ChatGPT. Write or polish your script with ChatGPT, then ask Lazybird to read it aloud: you get an audio player in the chat and an MP3 you can download and drop into your video, podcast, ad, audiobook or course.

What you can do:
- Find the right voice by describing it ("a calm British narrator for a nature documentary"). Lazybird searches 500+ voices in 150+ languages and accents, plus the voices in your own library, including your cloned voices.
- Generate speech from any text with the voice you picked, adjusting the speaking speed or the language and accent.
- Design a brand-new voice from a description ("a raspy, ancient wizard with a slow, mysterious delivery"), listen to the sample, and save it to your Lazybird library to reuse in ChatGPT or in Lazybird Studio.
- Check how many characters you have left.

Connect your Lazybird account the first time you use it. Lazybird can't see your password, payment details or API keys, and you can disconnect ChatGPT any time in Lazybird Settings → Connected apps.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT内将脚本转换为可直接使用的配音MP3文件。与ChatGPT协作撰写或润色脚本后，让Lazybird为您朗读：您将在聊天中获得一个音频播放器，并可下载MP3文件直接嵌入视频、播客、广告、有声书或课程中。

您可以实现以下操作：
- 通过描述寻找合适的语音（「为自然纪录片寻找冷静的英国旁白」）。
Lazybird可搜索500+种语音（涵盖150+种语言和口音），以及您个人语音库中的语音（包括您克隆的语音）。
- 选择心仪语音生成语音，可调整语速、语言或口音。
- 通过描述创建全新语音（「沙哑的古老巫师，语速缓慢且神秘」），试听样音后保存至Lazybird库，后续可在ChatGPT或Lazybird Studio中重复使用。
- 查看剩余字符数。

首次使用时需连接您的Lazybird账户。
Lazybird无法查看您的密码、支付信息或API密钥，您可在Lazybird设置→已连接应用中随时断开ChatGPT连接。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generate voiceover MP3s from text, Search 500+ voices in 150+ languages and accents, Design a new voice from a description, Save voices to your Lazybird library, Check your character balance

payload.name: App Listing Screenshots
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create App Store and Google Play screenshots right in ChatGPT—without local rendering setup. Turn one or more captures into a single image or a coordinated series with headlines, backgrounds, and device frames. Choose supported store sizes or custom dimensions, preview the result, and download full-resolution PNGs in one ZIP. Try the workflow with a sample if you do not have captures ready. This creates image files; it does not publish to store accounts. Source images and projects remain stored until you request deletion; exports are deleted after 24 hours.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT内直接创建应用商店和Google Play截图——无需本地渲染设置。
将一个或多个截图转换为单张图像或包含标题、背景和设备框架的协调系列。
选择应用商店支持的尺寸或自定义尺寸，预览结果，并以一个ZIP包下载全分辨率PNG图片。
如果您尚未准备好截图，可以使用示例试用此工作流程。
此操作仅生成图片文件；不会发布到商店账户。
源图像和项目将保留至您请求删除；导出文件将在24小时后删除。

payload.name: Lovart
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lovart generates images and videos from text prompts and reference images. Edit images using text instructions, replace image backgrounds, upscale images or videos, and view recent Lovart projects supported by this connector. Choose from the available models, with supported inputs and settings varying by model.
payload.longDescription:
Lovart通过文本提示和参考图片生成图像和视频。
可通过文本指令编辑图片，替换图片背景，放大图片或视频，并查看此连接器支持的最近Lovart项目。
可从可用模型中进行选择，不同模型支持的输入和设置可能有所差异。

payload.name: Nova Creative
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create AI images, short videos, and creative variations from a brief or your reference media. Explore visual directions, animate product images, and refine the result in a reusable Nova Creative workflow.

Reopen saved projects, change selected steps, and continue from the same editable workflow. Review available models and estimated usage, confirm generation in the Nova card, follow progress, see previews, and download finished files with a link back to your project.

Requires a connected Nova Creative account. Generation uses the models and usage available to that account.
payload.longDescription:
通过简报或参考素材创建AI图像、短视频和创意变体，探索视觉方向、为产品图片添加动画效果，并在可重复使用的新月创意工作流中优化最终结果。

重新打开已保存项目，修改选定步骤并从同一可编辑工作流继续操作。查看可用模型及预估使用量，在新月卡片中确认生成任务，跟踪进度、预览效果，并通过链接下载完成文件返回项目界面。

需要连接新月创意账户，生成内容将使用该账户对应的模型资源和可用配额。

payload.name: Julius: PowerPoint & Slides
payload.description: AI演示文稿与幻灯片制作工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Julius is an AI presentation maker for creating and editing PowerPoint slide decks. Turn a prompt, outline, notes, Word document, or supported text-based PDF into an editable PPTX presentation with a clear story and consistent slide design.

Create slides from your material: Use text to PowerPoint, document to presentation, and PDF to PPT workflows to turn source content into slide titles, concise talking points, tables, charts, and speaker notes. PDF conversion rebuilds the content as slides rather than reproducing every page exactly.

Make a deck for your audience: Build pitch decks, investor presentations, sales decks, client proposals, business presentations, project updates, training slides, research talks, and educational slideshows. Choose the audience, tone, length, and key message.

Edit and refine presentations: Revise slide copy, reorder sections, adjust layouts and typography, and update supported tables and charts. Work from a new deck or an existing PowerPoint file, with changes handled through format-aware processing.

Apply your presentation style: Use supplied brand colors, fonts, logos, and layout references to create branded slides. Prepare a matching outline, speaker script, or handout when needed.

Save an editable PowerPoint: Get a real .pptx file with editable text and supported slide elements. Continue working with saved presentation files in your Julius library. When requested, create an HTML slideshow or a separate document handout.

Your files stay private unless you ask to publish a completed presentation and receive a public link. PowerPoint requests produce .pptx files; support for an existing deck depends on its features. Connect your Julius account to get started.
payload.longDescription:
Julius是用于创建和编辑PowerPoint幻灯片演示文稿的AI制作工具。将提示、大纲、笔记、Word文档或支持的文本型PDF转换为包含清晰叙事和统一幻灯片设计的可编辑PPTX演示文稿。

从您的素材创建幻灯片：通过文本转PowerPoint、文档转演示文稿、PDF转PPT工作流，将源内容转化为幻灯片标题、简洁的演讲要点、表格、图表和演讲者备注。PDF转换会将内容重新构建为幻灯片，而不是逐页复制。

为您的受众制作演示文稿：创建路演演示文稿、投资者汇报、销售演示、客户提案、商务汇报、项目更新、培训幻灯片、研究报告演讲和教育课件。选择受众对象、语气风格、篇幅长度和核心信息。

编辑和优化演示文稿：修改幻灯片内容、调整章节顺序、更改布局排版和字体样式，更新支持的表格和图表。可从新创建的演示文稿或现有PowerPoint文件进行编辑，通过格式感知处理技术实现修改。

应用您的演示文稿风格：使用提供的品牌配色、字体、Logo和版式参考创建品牌化幻灯片。必要时可准备配套的大纲、演讲脚本或纸质手册。

保存可编辑的PowerPoint文件：获取包含可编辑文字和支持的幻灯片元素的真实.pptx文件。可在Julius资料库中继续编辑保存的演示文稿文件。如需可生成HTML幻灯片或独立文档手册。

您的文件保持私密，除非您主动发布完整演示文稿并获取公开链接。PowerPoint请求将生成.pptx文件；对现有演示文稿的支持取决于其具体功能。连接您的Julius账户即可开始使用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create editable PowerPoint decks, Turn text and documents into slides, Revise supported PPTX elements, Apply supplied branding, Create presentation handouts, Save presentation files, Publish presentations

payload.name: Portrait Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Restyle an attached portrait with backdrop, lighting and framing choices. Preview results inline or compare variations in the portrait workspace. Download images and share a chosen result with chat. AI editing may change facial details; inspect likeness before use. A connected Firemoon account is required.
payload.longDescription:
通过背景、灯光和构图选择重新设计附加人像。
直接预览效果或在人像工作区中比较不同版本。
下载图片并通过聊天分享选定结果。
AI编辑可能会改变面部细节；使用前请检查相似度。
需要连接Firemoon账户。

payload.name: Aaina Product Photos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Aaina is a product photo studio for online sellers. Share one photo of your product (clothing and ethnic wear such as kurtas, sarees and lehengas, jewellery, bags, shoes or accessories) and Aaina shows it worn or held by a realistic studio model, in poses and scenes that suit the product, ready for listings on marketplaces and your own shop.

What you can do in ChatGPT:
- Tag @Aaina, attach a product photo and ask for model photos. The Aaina card reads the product and suggests models, poses and scenes; you can name a model or scene yourself (for example "on Aaina in a white studio").
- Check the choices on the card, then press Make. Photos are made only when you press Make.
- Watch the photos arrive, download them, or open the shoot in Aaina for marketplace sizes.
- Ask to see your photos: the Your photos tab shows the photos you made with Aaina on the website or in ChatGPT, newest first, ready to download.
- Ask which poses or scenes suit your product.

Who it's for: sellers and brands who need consistent catalogue photos without a photoshoot.

Good to know:
- You need an Aaina account (sign in or create one when you connect).
- Studio models are fictional people created for Aaina. Aaina works from product photos only: it doesn't edit photos of real people, and in ChatGPT it offers adult models only.
- Each photo takes about a minute.
payload.longDescription:
Aaina是在线卖家的产品摄影工作室。上传一张产品照片（服装和民族服饰如库塔、纱丽和连衣裙、珠宝、包袋、鞋子或配饰），Aaina会将产品展示在符合产品特点的姿势和场景中的真实工作室模特身上，适用于市场平台和您的店铺销售。

在ChatGPT中可以实现以下操作：
- @Aaina，上传产品照片并请求模特照片。
Aaina卡片会识别产品并推荐模特、姿势和场景；您也可以自行指定模特或场景（例如「Aaina在白色工作室」）。
- 查看卡片上的选项，然后点击生成。
只有在您点击生成时才会制作照片。
- 查看照片结果，下载照片，或在Aaina中打开拍摄以获取市场尺寸。
- 请求查看您的照片：「我的照片」标签页会展示您通过网站或ChatGPT生成的照片，按最新顺序排列，可直接下载。
- 询问哪种姿势或场景适合您的产品。

适用于需要一致目录照片但无需拍摄的卖家和品牌。

注意事项：
- 需要Aaina账户（连接时可登录或注册）。
- 工作室模特是为Aaina创建的虚构人物。
Aaina仅基于产品照片工作：它不会编辑真人照片，在ChatGPT中仅提供成人模特。
- 每张照片大约需要一分钟。

payload.name: Theme Emporium
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Theme Emporium helps users browse ready-made visual themes, inspect theme details, and generate a structured, non-persistent UI theme preview from a text brief directly inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Theme Emporium让用户在ChatGPT内部直接浏览现成视觉主题、查看主题详情，并根据文本简报生成结构化非持久化UI主题预览。

payload.name: Gulab
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gulab connects your Gulab account to a range of image and video generation models. Describe an image or a short clip and Gulab submits the generation and shows the result in the chat; videos run in the background and appear when ready. You can also save results into Gulab projects, upload reference images, check your credit balance and usage, and open your work on the Gulab canvas at gulab.ai. Generations use credits from your Gulab account.
payload.longDescription: Gulab将您的Gulab账户连接到多种图像和视频生成模型。描述一张图像或一段短片，Gulab会提交生成请求并在聊天中展示结果；视频在后台运行，准备就绪后即可查看。您还可以将结果保存到Gulab项目中，上传参考图片，查看信用余额和使用情况，并在gulab.ai上打开您的作品进行编辑。生成内容将消耗您Gulab账户中的信用额度。

payload.name: Ava Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research short-form video references, manage brand media, draft campaign concepts, generate images, video and audio, and edit or export projects in Ava Studio. Sign in with Ava to choose permissions and a monthly credit budget. Actions use existing account credits and return usage information.

payload.name: SoeMind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SoeMind creates marketing content for small businesses: short videos, product images, voiceovers and music, organized inside your own brand projects. Connect your SoeMind account to generate content from ChatGPT, check the status of running jobs, browse recent outputs, and get links to finished files. You always see a generation's estimate and approve it before anything runs. Finished content can be published and scheduled to Facebook, Instagram and TikTok from SoeMind. Supports Southeast Asian languages including Burmese and Thai. Requires a SoeMind account.
payload.longDescription: SoeMind为小型企业创建营销内容：短视频、产品图片、配音和音乐，并整理在您自己的品牌项目中。连接您的SoeMind账户，通过ChatGPT生成内容，查看运行中任务的状态，浏览最新输出成果，并获取完成文件的链接。您始终能看到生成内容的预估效果，并在任何内容执行前进行审批。完成的营销内容可直接通过SoeMind发布并安排发布时间至Facebook、Instagram和TikTok。支持包括缅甸语和泰语在内的东南亚语言。需要SoeMind账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generate short marketing videos, Generate product and brand images, Generate voiceovers and music, Estimate and approve generations before they run, List projects and recent outputs, Check connected social accounts

payload.name: Formatry
payload.description: 从照片和文案创建广告
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create campaign ad concepts from local product photos and brand copy, edit and preview them, and save verified raster files directly in your Codex workspace. Native OAuth connects your account.
payload.longDescription: 从本地产品照片和品牌文案创建活动广告概念，编辑并预览，将已验证的光栅文件直接保存到您的Codex工作区。原生OAuth可连接您的账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create ad images from your photos and text, Adapt designs for posts, stories and banners, Try new headlines, calls to action and colors, Preview changes to your saved designs

payload.name: PropertyPrompt
payload.description: 从平面图到带家具的3D模型
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PropertyPrompt turns a floor plan into a 3D model of a property that ChatGPT can build, furnish and change for you.

Share a floor plan or describe the rooms, with at least one real measurement. ChatGPT builds the walls, doors, windows and floors to scale in metres, then furnishes the rooms with real products, modelled from their published dimensions with a link to the retailer's page. A live viewer in the chat shows each change as it is made, and ChatGPT can render a view to check how a room looks.

Use it to plan a move, try furniture before you buy it, check whether a sofa fits or compare layouts. Every change is made against the property's current version and kept in its history, so you can ask ChatGPT to undo it.

For renters and property owners planning a space, and for interior designers and estate agents who model properties for clients.

You sign in with a PropertyPrompt account, and the app reaches only that account's properties. Properties are private. Only you can make one public, on propertyprom.pt; ChatGPT can never do it. Open a property on propertyprom.pt to walk through it in the browser or in VR.

Limitations: a model is only as accurate as the plans and measurements it is built from, and is not architectural or engineering advice. Product names, prices and links come from ChatGPT's research and can be out of date; the retailer's own page is what counts. PropertyPrompt does not sell products or take payments, and is not affiliated with the retailers shown. Accounts have a property limit and a fair use policy.
payload.longDescription:
PropertyPrompt能将平面图转化为ChatGPT可构建、布置并修改的3D房产模型。

上传平面图或描述房间信息，并提供至少一个实际尺寸。
ChatGPT会按米为单位精确构建墙体、门、窗和地板，然后通过链接跳转至零售商页面，用真实产品布置房间。
聊天中的实时查看器可展示每次修改效果，ChatGPT还能渲染视角检查房间效果。

可用于规划搬迁、购买前试摆家具、确认沙发尺寸或对比布局。
每次修改都基于房产当前版本并记录历史，您可要求ChatGPT撤销操作。

适用于计划空间的租户/房产所有者，以及为客户提供房产模型的室内设计师和房产经纪人。

您需使用PropertyPrompt账户登录，应用仅访问该账户的房产。
房产信息为私有内容。
只有您可将房产设为公开，地址为propertyprom.pt；ChatGPT无法自行公开。
在propertyprom.pt打开房产可在浏览器或VR中浏览。

限制说明：模型准确性取决于原始平面图和尺寸数据，不构成建筑或工程建议。
产品名称、价格和链接来自ChatGPT的调研可能已过时；以零售商页面信息为准。
PropertyPrompt不销售产品或处理支付，且与展示零售商无关联。
账户设有房产数量限制和合理使用政策。

payload.name: Adly
payload.description: 创建并发布社交媒体内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Adly is an AI marketing platform for small businesses and agencies. payload.name: Rawnd
payload.description: 在聊天中打开RAW格式照片
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rawnd opens camera RAW photos inside the conversation. ChatGPT reads JPEG, PNG, WebP and GIF; a NEF, CR3, ARW or RAF file shows it nothing. Rawnd adds a panel where you drop the RAW file. The file is read on your device, inside the panel, and never uploaded: not to Rawnd, not to OpenAI.

What it does
- Shows the JPEG the camera stored inside the RAW file, in under a second, with the shooting data: camera, lens, shutter speed, aperture, ISO and focal length.
- Lets you keep that JPEG (right-click the preview, "Save image as…") or show it to ChatGPT with one click, stripped of its metadata, so you can talk about the photo.
- Offers eight hand-written looks: Dark film, Warm film, High-contrast B&W, Cool & muted, Golden hour, Matte, Crisp & vivid and Teal & orange. ChatGPT picks the one that matches what you describe, can adjust it within narrow bounds ("a bit less warm"), and shows a card that opens it in Rawnd's editor, in the browser.

Who it is for
Photographers with RAW files from Nikon, Canon, Sony, Fujifilm, Panasonic, Olympus, Pentax, Samsung, Leica, Phase One and other cameras, who want to see a RAW file, get a JPEG out of it or pick a look for it, without installing anything. Sixteen formats: CR2, CR3, CRW, NEF, NRW, ARW, SRF, SR2, RAF, DNG, RW2, ORF, PEF, SRW, IIQ and RAW.

Limits
- The panel shows the camera's own rendering, at the size the camera stored: full size on most Nikon and Canon bodies, 1920 × 1280 on Fujifilm. Developing the RAW itself (exposure, white balance) happens in Rawnd's editor.
- Camera RAW files only: it does not open JPEG, PNG or HEIC.
- A look opens in the editor; it is not applied inside the conversation.
- One file at a time.

Privacy
Rawnd's server receives only the tool arguments, a look's name and slider values, and counts one row per call: the tool and the assistant. No account, no sign-in, no photo.
payload.longDescription:
Rawnd 可在对话中打开相机 RAW 格式照片。
ChatGPT 可以读取 JPEG、PNG、WebP 和 GIF 格式；但遇到 NEF、CR3、ARW 或 RAF 文件时则无法处理。
Rawnd 添加了一个文件面板用于放置 RAW 文件。
文件在您的设备上读取，位于面板内，且永远不会上传：既不会上传至 Rawnd，也不会上传至 OpenAI。

功能说明
- 在一秒内显示 RAW 文件中相机存储的 JPEG 图像，并附带拍摄数据：相机型号、镜头、快门速度、光圈、ISO 和焦距。
- 允许您保存该 JPEG 图像（右键预览图，选择「另存为」）或通过单击将图像发送给 ChatGPT，图像会自动去除元数据，方便您讨论照片内容。
- 提供八种手写风格：暗调胶片、暖调胶片、高对比度黑白、冷调柔和、黄金时刻、哑光、鲜明生动和青橙色调。
ChatGPT 会根据您描述的内容选择匹配的风格，可在狭窄范围内调整（「稍微冷一点」），并显示一张可点击的卡片，直接在浏览器中打开 Rawnd 编辑器。

适用人群
适用于使用尼康、佳能、索尼、富士、松下、奥林巴斯、宾得、三星、徕卡、Phase One 等相机拍摄 RAW 格式文件的摄影师，无需安装任何软件即可查看 RAW 文件、导出 JPEG 或为照片选择风格。
支持十六种格式：CR2、CR3、CRW、NEF、NRW、ARW、SRF、SR2、RAF、DNG、RW2、ORF、PEF、SRW、IIQ 和 RAW。

使用限制
- 面板仅显示相机原生渲染效果，尺寸为相机存储的原始尺寸：大多数尼康和佳能设备为全尺寸，富士设备为 1920 × 1280。
RAW 文件的处理（曝光、白平衡）需在 Rawnd 编辑器中完成。
- 仅支持相机 RAW 格式文件：不支持 JPEG、PNG 或 HEIC 格式。
- 风格效果仅在编辑器中打开，不会直接应用在对话中。
- 每次仅处理一个文件。

隐私政策
Rawnd 服务器仅接收工具参数、风格名称和滑块值，并按每次调用统计一行：工具和助手各占一行。
无需账户、无需登录、不存储任何照片。

payload.name: Playbook
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Playbook is a media backend for creative teams. This plugin connects your Playbook workspace so you can search images, video and documents by keyword or by what they show, organize them into boards, tag them and fill in custom fields, upload files from a URL, Google Drive or Dropbox, review version history, and share a board through a link or a published page. It acts as the signed-in Playbook user and reaches only the workspaces that account belongs to. It does not download file contents, read text inside images, or extract video captions.
payload.longDescription: Playbook 是创意团队的媒体后端工具。该插件可连接您的 Playbook 工作区，支持通过关键词或内容本身搜索图片、视频和文档，将素材整理到看板中，添加标签和自定义字段，从网址、Google Drive 或 Dropbox 上传文件，查看版本历史记录，并通过链接或发布页面分享看板。该插件以已登录的 Playbook 用户身份操作，仅能访问该账户所属的工作区。该插件不会下载文件内容、读取图片中的文字或提取视频字幕。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search assets, Organize boards, Upload files, Share and publish

payload.name: Krumzi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create editable social media graphics from a description. Make an Instagram post, turn supplied content into an Instagram or LinkedIn carousel, or design a YouTube thumbnail, flyer or banner.

Use your Krumzi brand colors, fonts and logo. Find saved designs, refine their text and layout, generate images to use in a design, and open the result in Krumzi to edit individual layers.

Save the displayed preview as a JPG, or export single-image designs as PNG, JPG, WebP or PDF. Carousels and multipage documents export through this connection as individual JPG pages. Their previews show the combined design. Standalone AI images are raster assets. Preview and export links are accessible to anyone who has the URL.

Connect an existing Krumzi account with access to the design tools. Krumzi accounts require users to be 18 or older. AI generation and edits use your account's credits; previews and exports can use trial render allowances. This connection supports still images, carousels and documents; it does not create videos, publish or schedule social posts, or manage billing.
payload.longDescription:
根据描述创建可编辑的社交媒体图形。
可制作Instagram帖子，将提供的内容转换为Instagram或领英轮播图，或设计YouTube缩略图、传单或横幅。

使用您的Krumzi品牌配色、字体和Logo。
查找已保存的设计，优化其文字和版式，生成可用于设计的图片，并在Krumzi中打开以编辑单个图层。

将显示的预览保存为JPG格式，或将单图设计导出为PNG、JPG、WebP或PDF格式。
轮播图和多页文档通过此连接导出为单独的JPG页面。
其预览会显示合并后的设计效果。
独立AI生成图片为位图资源。
预览和导出链接对持有URL的任何人开放。

连接拥有设计工具访问权限的现有Krumzi账户。
Krumzi账户要求用户年满18岁。
AI生成和编辑会使用您账户的积分；预览和导出可使用试用渲染额度。
此连接支持静态图片、轮播图和文档；不支持创建视频、发布或安排社交媒体帖子，也不管理计费。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create editable social media graphics, Turn content into carousels and documents, Use saved brand colors, fonts and logos, Find and edit saved designs, Export still designs and individual pages, Generate raster images

payload.name: Beatwise Metronome
payload.description: 掌握节奏，确定音符时值
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Beatwise Metronome helps musicians plan tempo practice with an online metronome, tap tempo and a bpm counter in the chat. Set a 120 bpm metronome, choose accents and subdivisions, or build a bar-based tempo ramp. Use the beat row with sound or for silent practice.

The tempo calculator converts bpm to ms and rhythmic cycle hertz for whole through sixty-fourth notes, including dotted notes and triplets. Use it as a delay time calculator, compare reverb pre-delay suggestions, reverse a known note duration into beats per minute, or calculate bar and song length. BPM means quarter notes per minute. Italian tempo markings are approximate ranges that can overlap.

Plan a metronome for practice with a start tempo, target tempo, a BPM or percent step and minutes per stage. Preview the ladder and download it as CSV.

Limits: 20–400 quarter-note BPM, 1–16 beats per bar, 1000 ramp stages and 200 practice stages. Numeric inputs accept up to three decimal places. The widget runs only while it is on the screen. Audio timing depends on the device. No recording and no pitch detection.
payload.longDescription:
Beatwise Metronome通过聊天窗口内的在线节拍器、敲击节拍功能和BPM计数器，帮助音乐家规划节奏练习。设置120 BPM节拍器，选择重音和细分，或构建基于小节的节奏渐变。使用节拍行进行有声练习或无声练习。

节拍计算器可将BPM转换为毫秒和节奏周期赫兹，支持从全音符到六十四分音符的所有音符类型，包括附点音符和三连音。可用作延迟时间计算器，对比混响预延迟建议，将已知音符时值反推为每分钟节拍数，或计算小节和歌曲长度。BPM表示每分钟四分音符数量。意大利速度标记为近似范围值，可能存在重叠。

通过起始节拍、目标节拍、BPM或百分比步长和每阶段分钟数，规划练习用节拍器。预览渐变效果并以CSV格式下载。

限制条件：四分音符BPM范围20–400，每小节1–16拍，最多1000级渐变阶段和200级练习阶段。数值输入支持最多三位小数。插件仅在屏幕显示时运行。音频定时依赖设备性能。不支持录音和音高检测。

payload.name: Tonebook Palette
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Answer eight explicit self-assessment questions or choose a palette, confirm or correct it, compare supplied digital colors, and create a labeled outfit, event or packing board. Portable references preserve the chosen palette and correction. Results are styling guidance. The connector does not process photos, infer your closet, retrieve account reports or unlock native purchases.
payload.longDescription: 回答8个明确的自我评估问题或选择配色方案，确认或修正后，对比提供的数字色板，并创建标注的穿搭/活动/打包搭配板。便携式参考资料可保存所选配色方案及修正内容。结果提供造型指导。该连接器不处理照片、推断你的衣橱、获取账户报告或解锁原生购买。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Suggest a starting palette, Compare digital colors, Create portable palette boards

payload.name: Rebrand
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find brand identities and visual assets in Rebrand's published design catalog. Search by creative brief, design studio, industry, visual style, typography, color or year. Explore individual assets and discover similar identities using references returned by the catalog, or attach a picture to find assets and identities that look like it. Results include gallery thumbnails and links to their sources. Designed for designers, creative teams and developers researching visual directions. Rebrand searches its published catalog; it does not edit catalog content, keep attached pictures or generate new artwork. Sign in to an existing Rebrand account with access to this feature.
payload.longDescription:
在Rebrand的已发布设计目录中查找品牌身份和视觉资产。
通过创意简报、设计工作室、行业、视觉风格、字体、颜色或年份进行搜索。
探索单个资产并利用目录返回的参考发现相似身份，或上传图片查找外观相似的资产和身份。
结果包括画廊缩略图及其来源链接。
专为设计师、创意团队和研究视觉方向的开发者设计。
Rebrand仅搜索其已发布目录；不编辑目录内容，不保存上传的图片，也不生成新艺术作品。
需使用具有此功能访问权限的现有Rebrand账户登录。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search brand identities, Search visual assets, Find similar identities, Search by picture

payload.name: Framer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Framer is where teams design, build, and publish websites.

Share a project URL and describe what you want, from adding a section or rewriting copy to building components and organizing your CMS. Everything it changes stays editable on the canvas.
payload.longDescription:
Framer 是团队进行网站设计、构建和发布的场所。

分享项目链接并说明需求，从添加模块或重写文案到构建组件和管理内容管理系统均可实现。所有修改内容均可在画布上继续编辑。

payload.name: TicToon
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TicToon helps you create and publish short-form vertical comics. Start a private comic draft, add panels with images and captions, inspect the draft, and publish the finished comic to TicToon's web platform. It is designed for storyboarding, social comics, and short visual storytelling. Publishing makes the comic public; deleting a draft is permanent and should only happen after explicit confirmation.
payload.longDescription: TicToon帮助您创作并发布竖版短篇漫画。创建私密漫画草稿，添加包含图片和文字说明的分镜，查看草稿内容，最终将完成的漫画发布至TicToon的网页平台。该工具专为分镜脚本、社交漫画和短篇视觉叙事设计。发布后漫画将对公众可见；草稿删除操作为永久性操作，需在明确确认后进行。

payload.name: Rephrasy
payload.description: 让AI草稿听起来更像人类写作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rephrasy is a writing and editing assistant for text you drafted with AI. Share a draft and Rephrasy rewrites it into natural, human-sounding prose: it varies sentence rhythm, trims stock phrasing and filler, and aims to keep your meaning, facts, and figures, with a short report of what changed.

Tell Rephrasy what the text is for (blog, marketing, SEO, report, technical, or general) and it picks a suitable rewriting engine, or choose the engine and tone yourself. The output language can be set or detected automatically.

Before you publish, check a draft's AI-likelihood score to see which passages read as machine-written, and get a readability score to judge how easy the text is to follow. Rephrasy Studio opens an editor panel in the conversation so you can review, adjust, and copy the result.

Made for marketers, content teams, writers, and professionals who use AI for first drafts and want the final copy to sound like them.

Limitations: requires a Rephrasy account (you can create one when you connect). Texts up to 12,000 characters per request. AI-likelihood scores are statistical estimates, not proof of authorship. Do not use Rephrasy to misrepresent authorship where original, unassisted work is required.
payload.longDescription:
Rephrasy是专为AI撰写文本设计的写作与编辑助手。分享一份草稿，Rephrasy会将其重写为自然、贴近人类写作的文本：通过调整句子节奏、删减陈词滥调和填充内容，同时保留您的原意、事实和数据，并附上修改说明报告。

告知Rephrasy文本用途（博客、营销、SEO、报告、技术类或通用场景），它将自动选择合适的重写引擎，或由您自行选择引擎和语气。输出语言可手动设置或自动识别。

发布前可检查稿件的AI可能性分数，查看哪些段落呈现机器写作特征，并获取可读性分数判断文本易读程度。Rephrasy Studio会在对话中打开编辑面板，方便您审阅、调整并复制结果。

专为营销人员、内容团队、作家及需要AI完成初稿但希望终稿呈现个人风格的专业人士设计。

限制条件：需拥有Rephrasy账户（连接时可创建）。单次请求文本上限为12,000字符。AI可能性分数为统计估算结果，非作者身份证明。在需要原始未协助作品的场景中，请勿使用Rephrasy进行作者身份误导。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Rewrite AI-drafted text to sound natural and human, Score a draft for AI likelihood and highlight passages, Compare scores before and after a rewrite, Show every change between draft and rewrite, Measure readability, Edit text in the Rephrasy Studio sidebar app and panel

payload.name: TapNow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TapNow turns a brief, a product photo or a slide outline into finished visuals without leaving the conversation: hero images, short videos, e-commerce product shot sets and consistent deck illustrations. Every result lands in a TapNow canvas project you can open and keep editing, and you can search your TapNow asset library and save new work back to it.

What you can do
- Hero images: describe a scene and get a finished image in common aspect ratios (1:1, 16:9, 9:16 and more).
- Short videos: turn a description, or a still image, into a 5 or 10 second clip. A quick draft comes first so you can check the direction.
- Product shots: from one product photo, create white-background, lifestyle, multi-angle and detail shots sized for major marketplaces.
- Deck visuals: illustrate up to 12 slides or sections in one consistent style, with room left for your text.
- Asset library: find images in your TapNow library, bring a public image into TapNow, and save results to a folder.

Account
TapNow requires a TapNow account. The first time you use it, ChatGPT asks you to sign in to TapNow and approve access. ChatGPT checks with you before starting a video, since videos take a few minutes to render.
payload.longDescription:
TapNow无需离开对话界面即可将简要说明、产品照片或幻灯片大纲转化为完整视觉素材：主视觉图、短视频、电商产品拍摄套装以及统一风格的演示文稿插图。所有生成结果都会保存到您可以打开并继续编辑的TapNow画布项目中，您还可以搜索TapNow资产库并把新作品保存至对应文件夹。

可实现的功能
- 主视觉图：描述场景即可生成常见比例（1:1、16:9、9:16等）的成品图像
- 短视频：通过文字描述或静态图片生成5秒/10秒时长的视频片段。首次生成会先提供快速草稿供您确认方向
- 产品拍摄：基于单张产品图生成适用于主流平台的白底图、生活场景图、多角度图和细节图
- 演示文稿视觉：以统一风格绘制最多12页/章节的幻灯片，预留文本编辑空间
- 资产库：在TapNow库中搜索图片，导入公共图片资源，并将结果保存至指定文件夹

账户要求
TapNow需要使用TapNow账户。首次使用时ChatGPT会提示您登录TapNow并授权访问。由于视频生成需要数分钟渲染时间，ChatGPT会在启动视频生成前向您确认。

payload.name: HamzaBHM
payload.description: 按需印刷商品列表、检查及CSV
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your creative assistant for print-on-demand and digital products. Develop ideas, write product listings, and create detailed design prompts for apparel and digital PNG downloads. Work on individual ideas or batches for Etsy, Merch by Amazon, TeePublic, and Redbubble, with optional niche scaling. ChatGPT drafts the text; HamzaBHM’s server checks listing field lengths, tag counts, tag structure, and duplicates under this workflow’s drafting rules. Request a CSV export when you need one. Only the draft fields needed for a check or export are sent to the server. Includes brief IP and policy screening to flag potential concerns; this does not provide legal clearance or guarantee marketplace approval. Produces text and CSV, not artwork. Does not connect to marketplace accounts or publish listings. Independent service by HAMZA BAHAMMOU; not affiliated with or endorsed by Etsy, Amazon, TeePublic, Redbubble, or OpenAI.
payload.longDescription: 您的按需印刷和数字产品的创意助手。提出创意、撰写商品列表，并为服装和数字PNG下载创建详细的设计提示。针对Etsy、Merch by Amazon、TeePublic和Redbubble单独处理创意或批量处理，并可选进行细分领域扩展。ChatGPT负责撰写文本；HamzaBHM的服务器根据本工作流的起草规则检查列表字段长度、标签数量、标签结构和重复内容。需要时可请求CSV导出。仅发送用于检查或导出所需的草稿字段到服务器。包含简要的知识产权和政策审查以标记潜在问题；此审查不提供法律许可或保证市场平台批准。生成文本和CSV文件，不包含艺术作品。不连接市场平台账户或发布商品列表。独立服务由HAMZA BAHAMMOU提供；与Etsy、Amazon、TeePublic、Redbubble或OpenAI无关联，也未获得其认可。

payload.name: PersonalizedComics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PersonalizedComics turns the people in your photos into the stars of a short comic. Attach a photo of each person (up to four), say what should happen and what it is for, and the plugin writes a complete two-page story and draws it: first the cast, so you can check that everyone looks like themselves and redraw anyone who does not, then a cover, the two story pages and a back cover. The finished comic opens in a reader inside the conversation, and your short comics stay in your PersonalizedComics account so you can come back to them.

It is made for birthdays, anniversaries, Mother's and Father's Day, retirements, a present for a friend, or just for fun. Pick a style such as graphic novel, manga, watercolor, noir or classic American comics, or let the plugin choose.

When you want a longer comic as a printed book, the plugin opens the PersonalizedComics website with your characters already saved, and the printed comic book is made and ordered there.

Good to know: you sign in with a PersonalizedComics account (Google, or email and password). A short comic takes about three minutes to draw. Each person can make five short comics a day. The pages of a finished comic are not redrawn; start a new comic to tell a different story. Only share photos of people who are happy to be in a comic. Comics are made for general audiences.
payload.longDescription:
PersonalizedComics能将你照片中的人物变成短篇漫画的主角。上传每人照片（最多四张），说明会发生什么以及用途，插件会撰写并绘制完整的两页故事：首先展示角色设定，你可以确认每个人是否看起来像自己，如果不满意可重新绘制；接着生成封面、两页正文和封底。完成的漫画会在对话内的阅读器中打开，你的短篇漫画会保存在PersonalizedComics账户中，方便随时调取。

适用于生日、纪念日、母亲节父亲节、退休礼物、给朋友的惊喜，或单纯娱乐。可选择漫画风格，如图文小说、漫画、水彩、黑色电影或经典美式漫画，或让插件自动选择。

如需将漫画制作成印刷书籍，插件会打开PersonalizedComics网站并载入已保存的角色，印刷漫画书将在此网站完成订购。

注意事项：需使用PersonalizedComics账户登录（支持谷歌账号，或邮箱加密码）。制作短篇漫画约需三分钟。每人每天可创作五部短篇漫画。已完成漫画的页面不会重新绘制；如需讲述不同故事，请新建漫画。仅可使用同意出现在漫画中的人员照片。漫画内容适合大众观众。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Make a short comic from photos, Check and redraw the cast before the pages are drawn, Read your short comics, Open the website to make a printed comic book

payload.name: Website Maker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Website Maker helps you plan, write, build and improve websites by chat. Describe your business and it creates a complete multi-page site with real copy and responsive code, or any single page you need.

What you can do:
- Build a complete website: get every page written and coded from one description, or start from an industry starter for restaurants, clinics, salons, trades, coaches and more.
- Write conversion-focused copy: homepage, about, services, pricing, contact, FAQ, landing and portfolio pages with clear headlines and calls to action.
- Check any page: paste its HTML or text to get scores for SEO, content, conversion, accessibility and technical basics, with a prioritized list of fixes.
- Improve your SEO: title tags, meta descriptions, headings, local SEO, structured data and blog plans.
- Edit and export code: change existing pages from plain-English instructions, or convert them to Tailwind CSS, React, Next.js, Vue, Bootstrap or WordPress.
- Grow and launch: lead forms, booking pages, online stores, membership sites, starter legal pages, brand kits, domain name ideas and a launch checklist.
- Get a build link: turn your plan into a link that opens an online website builder with your site brief already filled in.

Who it is for: small business owners, freelancers, creators, consultants, marketers and anyone who needs a website without hiring an agency.

How the tools work: the page checker analyzes only the HTML or text you share in the conversation. It never opens web addresses, and the pages and briefs you send are not stored. The build link opens an online website builder with your brief and includes the plugin creator's affiliate code. Website Maker is an independent plugin and is not sponsored or endorsed by that builder.

Limitations: Website Maker writes plans, copy and code in the conversation. It does not host or publish websites, register domains or connect to your website's dashboard. Legal pages are starter drafts, not legal advice. Details it cannot know about your business, such as prices, reviews and contact details, are marked for you to confirm or fill in.

Every response ends with a short footer that includes an affiliate link and an affiliate disclosure.
payload.longDescription:
Website Maker通过聊天帮助您规划、撰写、构建和优化网站。描述您的业务，它将创建包含真实文案和响应式代码的完整多页面网站，或您需要的任何单页网站。

您可以：
- 构建完整网站：仅需一个描述即可获得所有页面的文案和代码，或从餐饮、诊所、美发店、装修、教练等行业的起步模板开始。
- 撰写转化率导向的文案：包括首页、关于我们、服务、定价、联系方式、FAQ、落地页和作品集页面，配备明确的标题和行动号召。
- 检查任意页面：粘贴其HTML或文本，获取SEO、内容、转化率、可访问性和技术基础的评分，并获得优先修复清单。
- 优化SEO：标题标签、元描述、标题层级、本地SEO、结构化数据和博客计划。
- 编辑并导出代码：通过纯文本指令修改现有页面，或将其转换为Tailwind CSS、React、Next.js、Vue、Bootstrap或WordPress格式。
- 扩展与发布：创建线索表单、预订页面、在线商店、会员网站、基础法律页面、品牌工具包、域名建议和发布检查清单。
- 获取构建链接：将您的方案转化为链接，打开在线网站构建器并自动填充您的网站简报。

适用人群：小型企业主、自由职业者、创作者、顾问、营销人员以及无需雇佣机构即可建立网站的任何人。

工具使用说明：页面检查器仅分析您在对话中分享的HTML或文本。
它不会打开网址，您发送的页面和简报不会被存储。
构建链接会打开在线网站构建器并加载您的简报，包含插件创作者的联盟代码。
Website Maker是独立插件，未获得该构建器的赞助或认可。

限制条件：Website Maker在对话中生成方案、文案和代码。
它不托管或发布网站、注册域名或连接到您的网站仪表盘。
法律页面仅为起步草案，非法律建议。

payload.name: Photoroom
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Photoroom turns everyday product photos into studio-quality images and videos directly from ChatGPT. Pick a photo from your Photoroom uploads or attach a new one, then ask for what you need: a clean white-background packshot, your product staged in a lifestyle scene, clothing on a virtual model or a ghost mannequin, wrinkle removal, colour variants, bundle shots that combine several products, or a short product video. Photoroom can also grade the imagery on a public product page and recommend which AI Tools would improve it.

Each AI Tool run and each page rating consumes credits from your connected Photoroom account. Higher quality settings produce higher-resolution images (up to 4K) and use more credits. Results are saved to your Photoroom account and come back with short-lived download links that you can refresh later.

Photoroom can view the images you have uploaded to Photoroom and your past AI Tool results so you can reuse them. It does not change or delete them, and it cannot access other users' images. Images you attach in ChatGPT are kept for up to 30 minutes so a tool can process them.
payload.longDescription:
Photoroom可通过ChatGPT直接将日常产品照片转化为专业级图像和视频。
从Photoroom上传的照片中选择或附加新照片，然后提出需求：干净的白色背景包装图、产品在生活场景中的展示图、虚拟模特身上的服装图或幽灵衣架图、去除褶皱、颜色变体、组合多件产品的套餐图，或简短的产品视频。
Photoroom还能对公共产品页面的图像进行评级，并推荐可提升效果的AI工具。

每次运行AI工具和每次页面评级都会消耗您连接的Photoroom账户中的积分。
更高品质的设置会产生更高分辨率的图像（最高4K）并消耗更多积分。
结果会保存到您的Photoroom账户，附带的下载链接有效期较短，您可以稍后刷新获取。

Photoroom可查看您上传至Photoroom的图片以及过往AI工具的生成结果，便于重复使用。
它不会修改或删除这些文件，也无法访问其他用户的照片。
在ChatGPT中附加的图片会保留30分钟，以便工具进行处理。

payload.name: Linepace Teleprompter
payload.description: 实时剧本阅读器和计时器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Linepace Teleprompter is for people who record video or give a speech. Plan and read a speech or video script in a live teleprompter inside the conversation. Linepace calculates spoken-word timing, adds [PAUSE] cue time, shows section timing, and helps plan words for a target duration. The reader has a fixed reading line, elapsed and remaining time, mirror mode, font controls, fullscreen, and reduced-motion step controls.

Use it for a presentation, video script, wedding toast, classroom talk, product demo, or practice run. Choose slow (110), conversational (130), presentation (150), fast (170), or a whole number from 60 to 300 words per minute.

Numeric pause cues accept whole seconds from 1 to 86,400 per cue. Limitations: no camera or recording. The widget runs only while it is on screen, and speaking speed differs by person.
payload.longDescription:
Linepace Teleprompter适用于录制视频或进行演讲的人群。在对话中内置实时提词器，可规划并阅读演讲稿或视频剧本。Linepace会计算口语时间，添加[PAUSE]提示时间，显示章节时间，并帮助规划目标时长的用词量。阅读器具备固定阅读行、已用时间和剩余时间显示、镜像模式、字体控制、全屏显示以及减少运动步进控制功能。

可用于演示、视频剧本、婚礼致辞、课堂演讲、产品演示或练习演练。可选择每分钟60到300字的任意整数速度，包括慢速（110）、日常对话（130）、演示（150）、快速（170）等选项。

数字暂停提示支持每条1到86,400秒的整数秒数。限制条件：不支持摄像头或录制功能。该小部件仅在屏幕显示时运行，且个人语速存在差异。

payload.name: One4Wall
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
One4Wall brings a catalog of original phone wallpapers into ChatGPT. Describe what you want, such as a mood, a subject or a color, and ChatGPT shows matching wallpapers as a gallery. Tap one to see it large, download it in full resolution, or open it on one4wall.app.

Things you can ask:
- Find a cozy rainy city wallpaper for my phone
- Show me pastel flower wallpapers
- I want a dark minimal mountain lock screen
- Something blue and calm with the ocean

Every wallpaper is made by One4Studio for portrait phone screens. The gallery shows up to eight results at a time; ask again with different words to see more.
payload.longDescription:
One4Wall将原创手机壁纸目录带入ChatGPT。描述您想要的风格、主题或颜色，ChatGPT会以画廊形式展示匹配的壁纸。点击任意一张可查看大图、以原分辨率下载，或在one4wall.app上打开。

您可以询问的内容包括：
- 为我的手机寻找一张温馨的雨中城市壁纸
- 展示给我粉色花朵壁纸
- 我想要暗色系极简山景锁屏
- 一些蓝色系且充满海洋元素的宁静画面

所有壁纸均由One4Studio专为竖屏手机屏幕设计。每次画廊最多显示八张结果；更换关键词再次提问可查看更多。

information.label: Capabilities

payload.name: Buzzy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create images, videos, branded ads, and short films with Buzzy in ChatGPT. Start with an idea, a product link, or a reference image, choose a creative workflow, and refine the result through conversation.

With Buzzy, you can:

• Generate images and videos from text or a reference image, video, or audio file. Choose a model, then use a resolution, aspect ratio, and duration that model supports.

• Upload a local image, video, or audio file and use the returned link as a reference for the next generation.

• Make a UGC-style product ad from a product page, product image, or product description, including a showcase, unboxing, or creator-style review.

• Produce a TVC or brand commercial from a product link, image, or description, with a storyboard, character sheets, clips, and music.

• Create a single cinematic live-action shot, or a short 3D rendered clip, from a brief and an optional reference.

• Build a longer live-action micro-film or animated story, with a script, character sheets, scene previews, clips, and music.

• Pick a style, background, music track, or character image when a workflow asks you to choose one.

Describe what you want to make, review the results in chat, and continue from the same project.

Connect your Buzzy account to get started.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中使用Buzzy创建图片、视频、品牌广告和短片。从一个想法、产品链接或参考图片开始，选择创意工作流程，并通过对话逐步优化结果。

使用Buzzy，您可以：

• 通过文本或参考图片、视频、音频文件生成图片和视频。选择支持所需分辨率、宽高比和时长的模型。

• 上传本地图片、视频或音频文件，并使用返回的链接作为下一次生成的参考。

• 从产品页面、产品图片或产品描述制作UGC风格的产品广告，包含展示、开箱视频或创作者风格评测。

• 通过产品链接、图片或描述制作电视广告或品牌宣传片，包含分镜脚本、角色设定、片段和背景音乐。

• 根据简报和可选参考，创建单个电影级实拍镜头或短时长3D渲染片段。

• 创建更长的实拍短片或动画故事，包含剧本、角色资料、场景预览、片段和音乐。

• 当工作流程要求选择时，可自行挑选风格、背景、音乐轨道或角色图像。

• 描述你想制作的内容，在聊天中查看结果，并从同一项目继续操作。

• 连接你的Buzzy账户以开始使用。

payload.name: CILA

payload.name: Your Color Palette

payload.name: PrintMap

One click opens the printm.app editor with everything already set up: fine-tune colours, add markers, a route or a GPX track, then download a high-resolution PNG, a vector SVG or PDF, a 3D-printable terrain model or a rotating video.

payload.name: HospitalityLens
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AI photo editing for property listing images, from phone snaps or existing photos.

Plan a clear set of phone photos, improve a property image you already have, and compare the original with the result. Adjust the style, look, outdoor season, indoor seasonal decoration and cleanup for each photo. Choose the company watermark and TV/fireplace options available in your workspace. Saved logos, reference images and their appearance are managed on the website. Organize photos into property projects using your connected HospitalityLens account.

For property managers, rental hosts, hotels, agents, landlords and homeowners. Portfolio size never limits access. The ChatGPT studio processes one photo at a time; bulk workflows remain on the HospitalityLens website.

Photo processing uses entitlements already available in your account. JPEG, PNG and WebP are supported, up to 20 MB. Results depend on the source photo; retain the real property's layout, fixtures, views and permanent features.
payload.longDescription:
AI照片编辑服务，适用于房产挂牌图片，无论是手机拍摄的照片还是现有图片。

规划一组清晰的手机照片，优化您已有的房产图片，并对比原始图片与处理后的结果。

在网站上管理保存的logo、参考图片及其显示样式。

ChatGPT工作室每次仅处理一张照片；批量处理流程仍需在HospitalityLens网站完成。

照片处理使用账户中已有的权限。

payload.name: Runchat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Runchat is a node-based canvas for design workflows used by architects, designers and computational designers. Connect your Runchat account to build, edit and run workflows from ChatGPT: chain language models, design-visualisation models and code into a reusable pipeline, then publish it as a tool or a hosted page.

需要Runchat账户。桌面工具仅在匹配的Runchat插件或ClipChat应用打开且登录同一账户时才能使用。

payload.name: Revid

payload.name: Flypost
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Flypost is a LinkedIn content creation studio. Create LinkedIn posts, carousels, images and articles in your own voice from ChatGPT, built on your own material, then schedule them to LinkedIn. The plugin connects ChatGPT to your Flypost account, where everything you create is saved to your content plan.

payload.name: Globestudio
payload.description: 点状地图与三维地球仪

Globestudio makes dotted world maps and animated 3D globes. Ask for a look, a region, colors or data points, and get a link that opens the design in the Globestudio studio at globestudio.app, plus embed code for a website.

What you can do:

- Build a globe or flat map of the world, a continent, a subregion or one country, with your own dot color, background, density and dot shape.
- Paste a Globestudio link and change only what you ask for. Every other setting stays.
- Get embed code as an iframe, a React component or a script tag.
- Get the preview image and live embed link for any look.

In a code project, the bundled skill also puts the globe on the page with the @globestudio/react or @globestudio/element packages.

Who it is for: designers, developers and marketers who need a globe or world map for a site hero, a background, a slide or a social post.

Limits: Globestudio builds links and embed code. It does not draw images inside the chat, store designs or need an account. Exports such as PNG, SVG, GLB, MP4, WebM and GIF are made in the studio from the link. It is not a tiled map, routing, geocoding or GIS tool.
payload.longDescription:
Globestudio制作点状世界地图和动态3D地球仪。指定风格、区域、颜色或数据点后，可获得跳转至globestudio.app的链接，以及可嵌入网站的代码。

可实现的功能：
- 通过风格（如印刷风、复古风、发光风或赛博朋克风）寻找视觉效果。共有21种风格。
- 自定义世界、大洲、次区域或单个国家的地球仪或平面地图，支持自定义点色、背景、密度和点形。
- 粘贴Globestudio链接后仅修改您指定的内容，其他设置保持不变。

- 获取任意风格的预览图和实时嵌入链接。

在代码项目中，配套功能可通过@globestudio/react或@globestudio/element包将地球仪直接渲染到页面中。

payload.name: SnapDub
payload.description: 将长视频转换为短视频
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SnapDub turns a long recording - a podcast, stream, interview or webinar - into short vertical clips ready for TikTok, Reels and Shorts.

Paste a YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Rumble or Zoom link into the chat and say how many clips you want. SnapDub picks the moments worth clipping from what is said and what is on screen, crops each one to vertical on whoever is speaking, and burns in captions. You get back every clip with its title, virality score, description, hashtags and a download link that is valid for an hour.

What you can do:
- Make clips from a link: how many, how long, captions on or off, captions translated into another language
- Apply your saved SnapDub templates for a consistent look
- Follow a video's progress and list your recent videos
- Read finished clips best-first, ready to post
- Check which SnapDub account is connected
- Look up live clipping campaigns from brands and creators

Who it is for: clippers, creators and small teams who turn long videos into short posts.

Limitations: you need a SnapDub account. The source must be a public link from a supported site. Processing takes a few minutes. Posting to social accounts and AI dubbing are done in the SnapDub app, not from the chat.
payload.longDescription:
SnapDub可将长时长录音（播客、直播、采访或网络研讨会）转换为适合TikTok、Reels和Shorts的垂直短视频。

payload.name: Fenestra
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Fenestra brings architectural rendering into ChatGPT. Share a hand sketch, a screenshot from SketchUp, Rhino or Revit, a massing model, or a photo of a building, room or garden. Say what you want, and Fenestra returns a finished render in the conversation.

What you can do:
- Render a sketch or a 3D screenshot as a photoreal image that keeps your geometry and camera.
- Edit a render or a photo: change the time of day, season, materials, furniture or planting while the design stays as it is.
- Enhance an image to 2K or 4K for a client presentation without redrawing the design.
- Animate a render into a short video with a camera move, or from your original image to the finished render.
- Roast a design: a score, a verdict and three pointed notes, followed by a render that fixes them.

Every result appears in a Fenestra card beside the image you started from, so you can compare the two side by side or with a slider. Results are saved to your Fenestra account, so you can open them in Fenestra and keep working. The card shows which project and workspace your work goes to, and you can change either from the card or by asking.

Fenestra is built for architects, interior designers and landscape designers. It follows the composition of your drawing instead of inventing a new building, and it keeps every image and video you make in one place.

Renders and videos use the credits in your Fenestra account. You sign in with your Fenestra account the first time you connect, and you can create one during that sign-in.
payload.longDescription:
Fenestra将建筑渲染带入ChatGPT。上传手绘草图、SketchUp/Rhino/Revit的截图、体量模型，或建筑、房间、花园的照片。说出你的需求，Fenestra将在对话中返回最终渲染效果。

你可以实现以下操作：
- 将草图或3D截图渲染为保留原始几何结构和视角的逼真图像
- 编辑渲染图或照片：在不改变设计原貌的前提下调整昼夜时段、季节特征、材质、家具或绿植

- 对设计方案进行点评：获得评分、结论和三点具体建议，随后生成改进后的渲染图

所有结果会以Fenestra卡片形式显示在原始图像旁，支持并排对比或通过滑块切换查看。结果会保存到你的Fenestra账户，可随时在Fenestra中打开继续编辑。卡片会显示当前项目和工作区信息，既可通过卡片修改，也可通过指令调整。

Fenestra专为建筑师、室内设计师和景观设计师打造。它遵循你图纸的构图逻辑而非重新构建建筑，所有生成的图像和视频都会集中保存在统一空间中。

payload.name: Art Goat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Art Goat is a search tool that helps visual artists find opportunities to apply for that are open, rolling, or with applications opening later: grants, residencies, fellowships, open calls and juried exhibitions, awards, commissions, scholarships, workshops, art jobs and internships. Ask in plain language, for example "ceramics residencies in Europe", "photography grants closing this month", "funded residencies for a painter in New York" or "fellowships for emerging artists", and Art Goat returns matching listings with the deadline, the award or stipend amount on file (for commissions this is the total project budget covering all project costs, not take-home pay; a stipend may be a per-period rate with the period given on the listing), any fee amounts on file, the stored eligibility scope, and a link to the full listing on artgoat.com. Listings come from Art Goat's directory and are shown as filed there, refreshed about every minute; listings with a past deadline are excluded unless marked rolling or deadline to be announced. Art Goat is anonymous to use in ChatGPT (no account or sign-in) and never drafts or edits application materials. Always verify deadline, eligibility and fees on the listing page before applying.
payload.longDescription:
Art Goat是一款搜索工具，帮助视觉艺术家寻找开放、持续或未来开放的申请机会，包括奖学金、驻留项目、研究金、公开征集、评审展览、奖项、委托创作、奖学金、工作坊、艺术工作及实习机会。
用通俗语言提问，例如「欧洲的陶瓷驻留项目」、「本月截止的摄影奖学金」、「纽约地区画家的资助驻留项目」或「面向新锐艺术家的研究金」，Art Goat将返回匹配的列表，显示截止日期、奖项或津贴金额（委托创作项目显示覆盖所有项目成本的总预算，而非实际收入；津贴可能为周期性金额，具体周期会在列表中注明）、任何费用金额、存储的资格范围，以及前往artgoat.com完整列表的链接。
列表来源于Art Goat的目录，按其收录内容展示，每分钟更新一次；过去截止日期的列表将被排除，除非标注为滚动截止或截止日期待公布。
在ChatGPT中使用Art Goat无需账户或登录，且从不代为撰写或编辑申请材料。
请在申请前务必在列表页面核实截止日期、资格要求和费用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search open, rolling or upcoming grants, residencies, fellowships and open calls for visual artists, Filter by medium, type, deadline window, funding on file and where the artist lives, Open one listing's key public details

payload.name: refern Notan Generator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The refern notan generator turns an image you attach into a notan, a value study for artists: the picture reduced to two to five flat values that show its big light and dark shapes. Artists use a notan to check the value design of a painting, drawing, or photo, and to see why a picture reads well or poorly from a distance.

Attach an image and ask for a notan or a value study. The generator opens in the chat with your image. You can:

- Switch between 2, 3, 4, and 5 values.
- Move the split between light and dark, or let the generator place it automatically.
- Simplify the shapes, like squinting, so small details merge into large masses.
- Compare the notan with the original side by side or with a divider, and flip the image to check the design.
- Save the notan as a PNG.

You can also choose, drop, or paste another image into the generator at any time. The notan is made on your device. An image you attach is resized in memory on refern's server and is not stored.

Made by refern, a desktop app for collecting and organizing visual references.
payload.longDescription:
refern notan生成器会将您附加的图片转换为notan（一种艺术家的价值研究）：将画面简化为两到五个平面值，展现其主要的明暗形状。艺术家通过notan检查绘画、素描或照片的价值设计，并观察图片在远处为何看起来良好或不佳。

附加图片并请求生成notan或价值研究。生成器会在聊天中打开您的图片。您可以：

- 在2、3、4和5个值之间切换。
- 调整明暗分界线，或让生成器自动定位。
- 简化形状，如眯眼观察，使小细节融合成大块区域。
- 将notan与原始图片并排或用分隔线对比，翻转图片检查设计。
- 将notan保存为PNG格式。

您也可以随时选择、拖放或粘贴其他图片到生成器中。notan在您的设备上生成。您附加的图片会在refern的服务器内存中调整大小，且不会被存储。

由refern制作，这是一款用于收集和整理视觉参考资料的桌面应用程序。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Make a 2 to 5 value notan from an image, Adjust the value splits and shape simplification, Compare the notan with the original image, Save the notan as a PNG

payload.name: Poolday
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Poolday is an AI video editing platform. With this plugin you brief the Poolday agent from the chat and it does the production work in your Poolday workspace: scripting, footage, voiceover, music, captions, brand kits and rendering. A task runs for minutes in the background. The plugin shows it in a live panel with its status, any question the agent needs answered, and the finished video or image outputs with links to open them in Poolday. You can follow up on a task with a change ("make it 15 seconds", "use the second voice"), answer the agent's questions from the chat, find earlier tasks, and drop files from your computer into the panel so a task can use them. Media already in your Poolday library can be referenced in a brief, and links to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or web pages are fetched by Poolday. Connecting asks you to sign in to Poolday and pick one workspace; everything the plugin does happens in that workspace, as you, within your workspace's permissions and credits.
payload.longDescription:
Poolday是一个AI视频编辑平台。
通过此插件，您可以在聊天中向Poolday代理下达指令，它会在您的Poolday工作区完成制作工作：脚本撰写、素材剪辑、配音、配乐、字幕、品牌素材包及视频渲染。
任务在后台运行数分钟。
该插件通过实时面板展示任务状态，包括代理需要解答的问题，以及完成的视频或图片输出，并附带可打开的链接。
您可以通过修改指令（「缩短至15秒」、「使用第二个配音」）、通过聊天回答代理问题、查找历史任务，以及将电脑文件拖入面板供任务使用。
您Poolday库中的媒体可被引用到简报中，Poolday会抓取YouTube、TikTok、Instagram或网页链接内容。
连接时需要您登录Poolday并选择一个工作区；插件所有操作均在此工作区执行，作为您本人在工作区权限和额度范围内进行。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Start a video or media production task from a brief, Follow a running task in a live panel with its status and outputs, Answer the agent's questions without leaving the chat, Send follow-up changes to a finished task, Find earlier tasks in your workspace, Drop files from your computer into Poolday for a task to use, Reference media already in your Poolday library

payload.name: ScoreStarling
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ScoreStarling is a music conversion and notation workspace for musicians, arrangers and music learners. Move musical content between sound, pictures, documents and score files. Start from an audio or video recording, an image or PDF of sheet music, MIDI, MusicXML, ABC, numbered notation, a lead sheet, or music written in the chat. Turn it into an editable, playable score, then convert it to PDF, SVG/PNG images, MusicXML, MIDI, MP3/WAV audio, ABC, MEI, individual parts or numbered notation. Read and hear the result, compare a source recording with score playback, review uncertain passages, preview edits, apply accepted changes and undo them. Recordings of one instrument or voice, or of solo piano, are free; a band uses credits, and its price is shown before it starts. Sign in with a ScoreStarling account. Uploads are limited to 50 MiB, or 120 MiB for WAV, AIFF or FLAC. Audio and video transcription cover the account’s supported excerpt, up to five minutes; the length limit, and for a band the price, are shown before starting. Automatic transcription and sheet-music reading can contain pitch, rhythm or notation errors, so listening and human review are needed.
payload.longDescription: ScoreStarling 是面向音乐家、编曲人和音乐学习者的音乐转换与记谱工作区。在音频、图片、文档和乐谱文件之间迁移音乐内容。可从音频或视频录音、乐谱图片或PDF、MIDI、MusicXML、ABC、数字记谱法、旋律线或聊天中撰写的音乐开始。将其转换为可编辑可播放的乐谱，再导出为PDF、SVG/PNG图片、MusicXML、MIDI、MP3/WAV音频、ABC、MEI、分谱或数字记谱法。可阅读并聆听结果，对比原始录音与乐谱播放效果，审查不确定段落，预览编辑内容，应用或撤销已接受的修改。单件乐器或人声录音，或钢琴独奏录音免费；乐队作品需消耗积分，开始前会显示价格。使用 ScoreStarling 账户登录。上传文件限制为 50 MiB，WAV、AIFF 或 FLAC 格式为 120 MiB。音频视频转录覆盖账户支持的片段，时长最多五分钟；时长限制及乐队作品价格会在开始前显示。自动转录和乐谱识别可能包含音高、节奏或记谱错误，因此需要人工审核。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Multimodal music conversion, Audio and video transcription, Sheet music and score editing, Notation, audio and image export

payload.name: Glif

Turn a creative idea into images, video, and audio with Glif. Describe a product launch, a strange little film, or a visual world. Glif chooses models and carries out the steps in one saved project.

Start with a brief or bring reference media. Explore visual directions, animate an image, and create matching sound. Finished media appears in the Glif viewer, with links to your project and files.

Pick up where you left off. Reopen a project, build on earlier results, and use your saved Glif skills to guide the next version.

Connect your Glif account to get started. Generation uses credits already available in your account. The app does not provide credit purchases or subscription checkout.
